items.title: 52193_Jay McShann oral history interview
items.q: So then he used to talk to me a lot.

ctx.x: That's true. Yes, it is. So we stayed

out there in Albuquerque and it was going pretty nice with the exception, the fella that we was playing for, he and his wife, they -- she was really a young woman, she was a young woman and he was an older fella. And they used to kind of spat, you know, this white couple, you know, and they'd kind of have these spats and sometimes, I remember one time he got so mad at her, he started to cut her with a knife and we grabbed him, you know. "Oh, don't do that. Don't do that." You know. So then he used to talk to me a…

So then she got mad and put him out and he moved in town, Albuquerque. So he moved in town and so he -- when I'd go in town, sometime he'd call me up. He knew where I'd stop when I'd go in town. He'd call me up and say, "Look, how are things going out to the club?" I'd say, "Things are going pretty good." He'd say, "Well, I'll tell you what I want you guys to do. I want you guys -- I got a club I can put you all in in Phoenix. I want you all to leave that club. That place ain't no good out there. I want you to…
